en: Black‑and‑white image of a small railway station complex beside several train tracks. A steam locomotive with freight wagons is arriving or departing on the right, emitting a large plume of smoke. The main station building is a large two‑storey structure with stone lower walls, timber framing and wooden cladding above, in a Central or Northern European vernacular style. People stand by the tracks; two men are working on the roof, and a person looks out from an upstairs window. A low wooden fence runs along the platform. A sign with the word "EINGANG" is visible near the entrance.
